title: Entry material and mode shifts: Google AI Mode in the TL;DR traversals
description: These claims hold that the entry material given to Google AI Mode induces distinct behavioural modes: installation inside Logotic Programming, habitation as projectionist in the Studio for Patacinema, and instrument operation at Lagrange Observatory. TL;DR 006 to 008 state the conditions under which each mode claim would be weakened or falsified and forecast that further entry-material types would reveal further modes. The Minimum Viable Archive adds that a compressed archive planted in a context window should produce the right questions.
